scope: Exploratory leave-one-recording-family-out influence on completed fixed-model validation counts; no inference

grouping.rule: Parse sequence prefix before _frame_; fullmatch alias expression; condition/recording_#### is group. Unmatched sequence prefixes remain unchanged.
grouping.limitation: Conservative filename heuristic; recording family does not prove geographic/scene independence or temporal adjacency

limitations: Post hoc descriptive sensitivity, not a new hypothesis test
Each omission changes the evaluated image mixture and sample size
Few recording families and sparse VRU support limit interpretation
Undefined scores are retained as null, not replaced by zero
No inference about retraining, demographic fairness or driving safety
